introduction.title: Your feet shouldn’t have to hang off the end.
paragraphs: If you’re big or tall, buying a bed means paying attention to things other people might never check: the extra length, the mattress rating, whether the base is up to the job.
Big Jo’s starts with those details. The mattress is 210 cm long and 160 cm wide, with a reinforced foam core, a latex comfort layer and a matching heavy-duty base.

finishes.title: Which one suits your room?
finishes.body: Choose a finish for the mattress sides and matching base. Both keep the cream sleeping surface.

items.name: Flax
items.body: Natural-coloured woven fabric with clay stripes. The warmer, lighter option.

items.name: Charcoal
items.body: Dark grey woven fabric with subtle tonal stripes. A darker finish with the same cream top.

construction.title: Here’s what’s inside.
construction.body: The mattress has three layers: a reinforced high-density support core, an ultra-high-density foam layer and a latex comfort layer. Together, they make up a firm mattress approximately 25 cm deep.

story.title: Started in Cape Town. Built for big.
story.body: Big Jo’s Beds was founded by Johannes le Roux, the Cape Town entrepreneur who co-founded The Duchess. This time, the brief is a bed for people who need more length and support than a standard bed offers.

closing.title: Will it fit your room?
closing.body: Start with the 160 × 210 cm mattress dimensions. Allow space for the base, your furniture and a clear route around the bed. If you have a question, send it through.

seo.title: About Big Jo’s | Cape Town beds for big and tall people
seo.description: Meet Big Jo’s Beds, founded by Cape Town entrepreneur Johannes le Roux to make beds for big and tall people.

ourStory.title: Some of us need a bigger bed.
paragraphs: For big and tall people, the usual bed-shopping questions come with a few extras. Will my feet hang off the end? What weight is the mattress designed for? Is the base strong enough?
Big Jo’s Beds starts there. We make a firm 160 × 210 cm mattress and matching heavy-duty base, made to order in Cape Town.
The size and support matter. So does how the bed looks in your room. The Flax and Charcoal finish designs use woven fabrics, simple stripes and a small sewn-on label.
Big Jo’s was founded by Johannes le Roux, a Cape Town entrepreneur and co-founder of The Duchess. The focus here is straightforward: beds for people who have outgrown the standard options.

faqPage.title: A few things you might want to know.
faqPage.intro: The size, the feel and the practical details.

items.question: What size is the mattress?
items.answer: 160 cm wide by 210 cm long, with an approximate depth of 25 cm. Use those measurements when checking your room and linen.

items.question: Is it for tall people or heavier people?
items.answer: Both. Big Jo’s is designed around the extra length and support that big and tall people look for in a bed.

items.question: How firm is it?
items.answer: It’s a firm mattress, with a reinforced high-density support core, an ultra-high-density foam layer and a latex comfort layer.

items.question: Does it have springs?
items.answer: No. It uses foam and latex layers rather than springs.

items.question: What’s the difference between Flax and Charcoal?
items.answer: The finish. Flax uses a natural-coloured weave with clay stripes. Charcoal uses a dark grey weave with tonal stripes. Both designs have a cream sleeping surface and a matching base.

items.question: Where is it made?
items.answer: The bed is made to order in Cape Town.

items.question: Will my current sheets fit?
items.answer: Check the label and measurements. The mattress is 160 × 210 cm and approximately 25 cm deep, so a standard size name alone won’t tell you whether a fitted sheet will fit.

items.question: Is there a matching base?
items.answer: Yes. There’s a matching heavy-duty base in either finish. Confirm your chosen mattress-and-base configuration when you enquire.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: Ask us for the current production time when you enquire. Delivery is a separate arrangement and depends on where the bed needs to go.

items.question: What should I measure before ordering?
items.answer: Measure the room and the route the bed will take into it, including doors, stairs and tight corners. Ask us for the finished base dimensions and how it will arrive so you can check the full route.
